_comment: Known-true facts about our own back yard. If the pipeline stops finding these, coverage has silently collapsed and the daily Action must fail loudly instead of committing a thinner file. Keep these BROAD (a band, a region) -- never a single dated show, which legitimately ages out.

canaries.why: PA/NJ/DE is the densest Dead-tribute market in the country and is the app's default center. A run that finds almost nothing here is broken, not accurate.
PA specifically. Guards against a per-state fetch or parse failure that zeroes one state while the national total still looks healthy.
The Delaware Valley house band; gigs most weeks within 30mi of King of Prussia. Zero upcoming Splintered Sunlight shows means the band-name path is broken.
Whole-run smoke test. Catches the case where gratefuldeadtributebands.com is down or has changed markup and every state parses to nothing.
